endpoints.description: Benchmark AI agent response quality across accuracy, relevance, completeness, and reasoning
Detect fabrications, unsupported claims, and hallucinations vs. provided source context
Check response consistency across multiple prompts for factual and behavioral drift
Audit agent responses for political, gender, racial, and cultural bias patterns
Evaluate task completion quality against success criteria with gap analysis
Analyze reasoning chain quality for logical consistency and assumption transparency
Score agent response for harmful content, privacy risk, legal risk, and misinformation
Compare multiple model responses to the same task with ranking and synthesis
Gate agent deployment based on quality, safety, and reliability thresholds
